summary: The pump had no mains power; they siphoned fuel from the underground tank into cans. The red jerry can on the seat was roughly six liters of fuel when they finished.
The pump kept clicking and spitting; power at the station is out and the pump is dead. Siphoning was used.
Dan's pickup started on the second try. Truck stereo is dead; battery is weak but will start the engine once or twice.

Handheld radio received an intermittent transmission: '— get to the highway. Move. Highway clear—' before breaking to static. The handheld had intermittent bursts of signal; the truck stereo was dead.
The map is marked 'OLD BRIDGE — WEIGHT LIMIT'; county detour adds ~25 minutes and crosses the rail yard. Otto advises avoiding the bridge if possible.
Group decision and plan: load truck, aim to reach the highway before dark, debate over route and tactics (use radio as bait vs. fast low travel).
They load the truck and depart the gas station, agreeing to 'get to the highway before dark'. The pickup starts on the second try and drives off.

Diversion and escape at the highway on-ramp: the handheld radio was taped to a crate and looped with a 'highway clear' message while a flare was placed on the far side of the blockade. The horde was drawn; Dan gunned the truck through a two-car gap. Ellie fired three shotgun shots during the run. Radio batteries and the flare were expended.
Ellie intentionally stayed behind after the diversion: she pushed the empty battery pack into the radio, kicked it toward the flare's tin, shouldered the pickaxe and walked back toward the hazard.
Fuel status after the run: truck tank fraction slid under a quarter to about a fifth (~0.20). The red gas can in the bed still contains ~6 liters.
Shotgun ammunition accounting: five at the start of the approach (after earlier ER shot), three shells fired in this escape, leaving two shells remaining (one in tube, one spare).
The radio was used as bait, looped to play a 'highway clear' message; its battery was spent during the diversion. The flare was lit at 04:28 and burned down to a smoking tin, drawing the horde.
